korea_food_service_permits.csv.description: Primary compatibility file: UTF-8 CSV containing all 3,010,802 current-snapshot permit rows and all 26 canonical columns.

columns.source_key: Dataset category key: general_restaurants, rest_cafes, or bakeries.
columns.source_row_number: 1-based row number within the retrieved source CSV. Lineage aid only; not a stable business identifier.
columns.source_artifact_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact retrieved source artifact used to create this record.
columns.source_retrieved_at_utc: UTC timestamp when the source artifact was retrieved for this snapshot.
columns.authority_code: Local-government authority code from the source field 개방자치단체코드. Stored as text to preserve leading zeroes.
columns.management_number: Source management number (관리번호). Useful as a bounded continuity candidate, but not asserted as an official primary key.
columns.permit_date: Source permit date (인허가일자). This is an administrative permit date, not necessarily the physical opening date.
columns.permit_date_quality: Parse-quality flag for permit_date: VALID, MISSING, or INVALID.
columns.source_status_code: Raw business-status code (영업상태코드) from the source. No project-level active/closed mapping is imposed.
columns.source_status_name: Raw business-status name (영업상태명) from the source.
columns.source_detail_status_code: Raw detailed business-status code (상세영업상태코드) from the source.
columns.source_detail_status_name: Raw detailed business-status name (상세영업상태명) from the source.
columns.closure_date: Source closure date (폐업일자), when present. It is not treated as proof of an irreversible terminal event.
columns.closure_date_quality: Parse-quality flag for closure_date: VALID, MISSING, or INVALID.
columns.business_name: Business or establishment name (사업장명) reported in the current source snapshot.
columns.business_type_name: Business-type label (업태구분명) reported by the source.
columns.hygiene_business_type_name: Hygiene business-type label (위생업태명) reported by the source.
columns.lot_postal_code: Postal code associated with the lot-address field (소재지우편번호), stored as text.
columns.road_postal_code: Postal code associated with the road-name address (도로명우편번호), stored as text.
columns.lot_address: Lot-based address (지번주소) reported in the source snapshot.
columns.road_address: Road-name address (도로명주소) reported in the source snapshot.
columns.source_coordinate_x: Source X coordinate (좌표정보(X)) in EPSG:5174; interpreted as easting for this verified snapshot.
columns.source_coordinate_y: Source Y coordinate (좌표정보(Y)) in EPSG:5174; interpreted as northing for this verified snapshot.
columns.source_data_updated_at_raw: Raw source data-update timestamp text (데이터갱신시점). Kept as source text because timezone semantics are not normalized.
columns.source_last_modified_at_raw: Raw source last-modified timestamp text (최종수정시점). Kept as source text because timezone semantics are not normalized.
